description: This is a whimsical, stylized wooden wardrobe presented in a warm, translucent orange hue. The wardrobe features two upper doors and two drawers below. Each drawer has an ornate, metallic handle. The top of the wardrobe is crowned with a decorative, arched pediment. On the left side, the pediment is adorned with a large, realistic-looking eye and two red gem-like accents on either side. The right side of the pediment features a clock face with Roman numerals and hands, also flanked by red gem-like accents. The overall design suggests a fantastical or surreal piece of furniture.
